title: Display hints
description: Optional presentation data. Never affects calculations or saved state; apps may ignore it. Priority is a whole number where 0 is highest. Ties keep their written order, with pack load order as the final tiebreaker.

types.description: Hints for a content type's copies, by content type name.

kind.description: What the group holds: `fields` (the default), the character's `actions` as `computeSheet` lists them, or its `content` (copies and picks).

visibility.description: Where the group shows: `primary`, `secondary` (the default) or `background`. A background group is kept out of play views with all its members; the group's value is also the default for members that don't set their own.

members.description: A query whose matches join the group, so homebrew joins automatically: `type: field` for a fields group (fields can also join by listing the group in their own hints), `type: action` for an actions group, a content type for a content group. A content group's query may take `from`: `own` (the default: copies and content active through picks and grants) or `applied` (the character's applied entries whose source is of the type).

sectionBy.description: Content groups: each member's section key (an integer or a string), over `item` and `self`. Sections are ordered by key, numbers ascending; a section's label key is `groups.<id>.sections.<key>.name` (optional).

sortBy.description: Content groups: a number or string members are sorted by, then by instance order.

visibility.description: How prominently an app shows a group or value, a fixed meaning every app follows: `primary` is always on the sheet, compact views included; `secondary` is shown and may be collapsed; `background` is kept out of play views and shown when editing the sheet (base scores, maximums, per-level bookkeeping, overrides). `hidden` is separate: never shown.
Where the value shows: `primary`, `secondary` or `background`. Without it, a field takes its group's, else `secondary`. Not with `hidden`.

format.description: A display format, kept in sync with `data/display-formats.json`, or `{ bands: <set> }`: the value named by the first band of a result band set the field's pack sees whose `when` holds with `roll.total` the value. The engine never evaluates it.

bands.description: A result band set (`resultBands`) the field's pack sees; `bands.<set>.<band>.name` names the value.

unit.description: A unit ID; its text is `units.<id>.name` and `units.<id>.short`. Display only: converting units is the app's call.

input.description: Input hints for editors (a number from 1 to 30). Field min/max still apply.

hidden.description: An in-between helper value players should never see.

rolls.description: The rolls the field's tile starts: the first is the field's own (a tap), the others are offered beside it, in order. The app starts each with its `params`; parameters a roll doesn't give are asked or left out as when the player starts the action.

with.description: Companion fields shown in this field's tile, each role at most once: `modifier` signed after the value ("13 (+1)"), `max` as "x / y", `detail` a small second line. In a group where the field has a tile, a companion has no tile of its own. Not with `hidden`.

companionRole.description: How a companion is shown in a field's tile: `modifier` signed after the value ("13 (+1)"), `max` after it as "x / y" ("0 / 195"), `detail` a small second line. `modifier` and `max` take numbers.

fieldRoll.description: A roll a field starts: a rules action and literal values for some of its parameters. A field parameter's value is a field ID, a content parameter's an item ID.

action.description: A rules action: a local or qualified action ID.

stateHints.description: Hints for a state key of a content type's copies: a field hint without `groups`. `showWhen` sees the copy as `self` and its item as `item`; the key's own `min` and `max` still apply.

visibility.description: Where the state key shows: `primary`, `secondary` (the default) or `background`. Not with `hidden`.

unit.description: A unit ID; its text is `units.<id>.name` and `units.<id>.short`. Display only: converting units is the app's call.

input.description: Input hints for editors (a number from 1 to 30). Field min/max still apply.

hidden.description: An in-between helper value players should never see.

with.description: Companion state keys of the same copy shown in this key's tile, each role at most once. Not with `hidden`.

unit.description: A unit ID; its text is `units.<id>.name` and `units.<id>.short`. Display only: converting units is the app's call.

hidden.description: Kept off the item's card. A custom-item form still asks for it.
True when quantity never matters (class features).

contentQuery.description: A content group's members: a query with `from`. With `applied`, the members are the character's applied entries whose source is of the type, in file order, inactive and blocked ones included; in `where`, `sectionBy` and `sortBy`, `item` is the source's item and `self` the entry (`id` and its state, with defaults).
